lead: Arvind Kejriwal is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 16 August 1968 in Siwani.
As of 2026, he is 58 years old, and his birth date places him under the Leo sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Delhi Legislative Assembly and Chief Minister of Delhi and has been recognised with Ramon Magsaysay Award and CNN-News18 Indian of the Year.
The sections that follow break down Arvind Kejriwal's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

paras: His professional record lists politician and bureaucrat as his occupations.
